Simple 3-Step Process

How ordering works at Namma 3D Lab.

Whether buying ready-made items or manufacturing complex mechanical prototypes, our workflow is built for zero friction.

01

Choose or Upload

Browse our ready-to-ship pre-printed decor and desk gear, or upload your 3D model (.STL, .OBJ) for on-demand manufacturing.

02

Seamless WhatsApp Quote

Pick your material, infill, and color. All details are saved to our Google Sheet and pre-filled into WhatsApp so we can chat immediately.

03

Precision Print & Express Dispatch

Produced with ±0.10mm micron tolerance on our CoreXY farm, verified with macro photos, and dispatched across Bangalore in 24–48h.
